properties.name: app.s3-client.endpoint-url
properties.description: Base URL of the S3 bucket client endpoint. Overridden at runtime by the S3_CLIENT_ENDPOINT environment variable.

properties.name: app.s3-client.public-endpoint-url
properties.description: Base URL used to generate presigned URLs reachable by external clients. Overridden at runtime by the S3_CLIENT_PUBLIC_ENDPOINT environment variable.

properties.name: app.s3-client.access-key
properties.description: S3 bucket client access key credential.

properties.name: app.s3-client.secret-key
properties.description: S3 bucket client secret key credential.

properties.name: app.kafka.server-url
properties.description: Kafka bootstrap servers in host:port format (comma-separated for a cluster). Overridden at runtime by the KAFKA_BOOTSTRAP_SERVERS environment variable.

properties.name: app.kafka.group-id
properties.description: Consumer group id used by the invoicing service.

properties.name: app.kafka.auto-offset-reset
properties.description: Offset reset policy when the consumer group has no committed offset.

properties.name: app.kafka.concurrency
properties.description: Number of concurrent Kafka listener consumers.

properties.name: app.kafka.topics.paid-orders
properties.description: Kafka topic for paid orders consumed by the invoicing service.
